tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background everywhere. The app is dark only, with no light mode (ADR 0011).

tokens.name: bg-tint
tokens.usage: The hint of colour in the background: large ambient areas only, for example behind the Home hero. Only ink, ink-muted and ink-subtle go on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets and the tab bar, on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The search field, season tabs and quiet round buttons (close, back), on bg or surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the only thing that separates a control.

tokens.name: image-control-backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a small control drawn on an image, so it reads on light and busy images: the date pill on the Home hero (with a background blur), the follow circle on a poster card when not followed (no blur), the pull-to-refresh spinner over the hero. bg at 55%.

tokens.name: hero-secondary-action
tokens.usage: Show detail's follow button beside "Open in", over a background blur: light, as Apple TV's secondary button, so it reads on the hero's dark fade. ink at 18%.

tokens.name: image-control-edge
tokens.usage: A hairline light border (the thinnest line the screen draws), Apple TV style: around the date pill on the Home hero, the follow circle on a Home poster card, and the poster cards themselves. One token for all three. Never the only edge of a control: the pill and circle also have their fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on bg, bg-tint, surface and surface-raised. Also the fill of the white primary action over show images, and the tint of show logos.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines and secondary text ("Next: Fri 25 Sep", "2026 · Running · Apple TV") on bg, bg-tint, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Upcoming episodes that are not out yet, and data credits, on bg, bg-tint, surface and surface-raised. Holds 4.5:1 on all four.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The primary action on plain screens without a show image, and small status marks (the follow check, the calendar day line, the dot in the hero's Premiere chip). Also the focus ring. Over a show image the primary action is white (ink) instead. Never for decoration (ADR 0011).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Near-black, never white (ADR 0011).

tokens.name: episode-finale
tokens.usage: The dot in the Home hero's Finale chip, the one colour over a show image besides accent (a Premiere's dot is accent). Warm amber rather than red, which reads as an error or live. A small status mark beside its word, never alone and never for text.

tokens.name: service-unavailable
tokens.usage: The dot before "Unavailable" in a Shows or Search row's service line, in the logos' place: a muted yellow, as a warning that the show cannot be watched in the region; apart from red (destructive) and episode-finale's amber. A small mark beside its word, never alone and never for text.

tokens.name: episode-mark-edge
tokens.usage: The hairline outline of the Home hero's Premiere/Finale chip: brighter than image-control-edge, since the chip has no fill to set it off the fade.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: The fill of a destructive action, such as Unfollow revealed by a swipe. ink on it holds 4.56:1; the fill holds 3:1 on surface. Never for text or decoration.

tokens.name: tab-bar-background
tokens.usage: The fill of the floating tab bar, over its background blur (tab-bar-blur), so content scrolls visibly behind it. #2a2a2e at 50%.

tokens.name: tab-bar-edge
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar's hairline edge, tab-bar-edge-width wide. Never its only edge: the bar also has its fill.

tokens.name: tab-bar-active-pill
tokens.usage: The wide light-grey pill behind the active tab's icon. It fills a tab's slot and slides from tab to tab on tab-bar-spring. Neutral, never accent.

fonts.source: Google Fonts, bundled with the app (@expo-google-fonts/manrope)
fonts.usage: Trial: button labels only. Rolled back by pointing the button family at sans.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The show title on Home when a show has no logo. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Show detail title, and the month title in Calendar.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and row titles: show names in Shows and Search, episode titles on cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta lines, dates and statuses, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase badges on cards: NEW TODAY, TOMORROW, a date, FINALE.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Labels of primary buttons, for example "Open in [service]" on the Home hero. Trial: Manrope ExtraBold at -3% letter spacing (18 × -0.03 = -0.54px); one token, so a rollback to the system font is one change.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between inline items: a badge and its text, a poster and its title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, and padding inside controls such as the search field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Breathing room around the Home hero and above screen titles.

tokens.name: header-inset
tokens.usage: The side inset of Home's header bar (the app's logo): closer to the screen's edge than the content under it.

tokens.name: content-inset
tokens.usage: The screen's side margin for content: the Home hero's block and poster rows (which still scroll edge to edge), Shows, Search, Calendar and Show detail.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small posters in rows and episode stills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Home hero card, cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the search field and season tabs: every control is a pill.

tokens.name: tab-bar-blur
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar's background blur. In the app: expo-blur at intensity 90 (expo-blur draws blur(intensity × 0.2px) on the web, with its own fixed saturation).

tokens.name: tab-bar-edge-width
tokens.usage: The width of tab-bar-edge.

tokens.name: tab-bar-icon-stroke
tokens.usage: The stroke of the tab icons' outlines, on a 24 viewBox, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: tab-bar-icon-size
tokens.usage: The size the tab icons are drawn at.

tokens.name: tab-bar-padding
tokens.usage: Space inside the floating tab bar, around its tabs.

tokens.name: tab-bar-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the tabs.

tokens.name: tab-bar-tab-width
tokens.usage: Every tab's slot, active or not. The active pill fills it, so it is wider than tall.

tokens.name: tab-bar-tab-height
tokens.usage: Every tab's slot height. With tab-bar-padding and the edge, the bar is 60 tall.

tokens.name: tab-bar-bottom-gap
tokens.usage: The gap under the floating tab bar, above the bottom of the screen. Content ends 80 above the bottom, over the bar.

tokens.name: tab-bar-lift-scale
tokens.usage: Touching the bar, anywhere, lifts the whole bar to this scale and back on release: the bar's only size change. No size change on scroll.

tokens.name: tab-bar-spring
tokens.usage: The spring of the sliding active pill, the bar's lift and the hovered tab's scale (react-native-reanimated withSpring).
